A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Princeton365 dataset, ground-truth pipeline, and benchmarks. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MoCap validation, SLAM and novel-view-synthesis benchmark results, component ablations, and supplementary calibration and statistical analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 4-10 and the appendix validation analyses.

M1.justification: The board pose graph, median edge selection, optional snapping, multi-board PnP, Bundle PnP, and Bundle Rig PnP procedures remain unchanged. Revised explanations and pipeline graphics clarify the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 365 sequences: 285 scanning, 40 indoor, and 40 outdoor, with the same six-scene NVS benchmark. The new scene montage and Appendix O describe existing coverage without establishing added datasets or test scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 6 retains DPVO, DPV-SLAM, LEAP-VO, ORB-SLAM3, and COLMAP. The NVS comparisons retain Nerfacto and Splatfacto using the authors' or COLMAP poses; the MoCap, board-type, and calibration comparisons also retain their comparators.

E3.justification: Appendix A and Table 8 revise the stated medium filming-distance range from 70-120 cm to 70-150 cm. This changes a reported ablation setting, without establishing that experiments were rerun. Benchmark metrics, processing strides, and the 30K-step NVS training budget remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The same component, board-count, and filming-distance ablation comparisons remain in Tables 7-8. Board-type comparisons, relative-pose validation, bootstrap analysis, and indoor/outdoor checks are retained. The new NVS montage illustrates existing scenes without adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the 10,000-trial bootstrap procedure, trajectory-error standard deviations, and Appendix H's Welch test with its 95% confidence interval and p=0.832. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Appendix A corrects the stated ATE for 16 boards without Bundle PnP from 2.5 mm to 2.6 mm, matching Table 8 in both versions. Numerical entries in Tables 4-10 remain unchanged; v2's explicit 4.4-to-2.1 mm improvement restates existing ablation results.

T1.justification: The optimization objectives, IOF definition, alignment mathematics, and assumptions are retained. Explicit squared-norm notation and the separately named reprojection residual rewrite the existing least-squares objectives without changing their mathematical substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: a diverse dataset with accurate poses, a scalable ground-truth pipeline, the scale-aware IOF metric, and a challenging non-Lambertian NVS benchmark. The conclusion's metric-name correction does not redefine the contribution.

C2.justification: The diversity description becomes less categorical: v2 removes Figure 1's assertion that every video uses a unique environment and similar uniqueness wording in Section 3. Interpretations of accuracy, COLMAP failures, component benefits, and indoor-to-outdoor generalization otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix O discloses blurring of faces and license plates; this does not establish newly introduced preprocessing. Conversely, Section 5.1 removes the explicit statement that the camera and Vicon recordings were simultaneously captured at 60 FPS. The remaining implementation and access information is largely retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds a Vicon Motion Systems reference supporting the stated 0.201 mm RMSE accuracy. Existing cited research and the positioning against SLAM and NVS benchmarks remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 tightens paragraphs and captions, fixes grammatical errors, clarifies reference-board terminology, and standardizes the conclusion's metric name to Induced Optical Flow. It adds Appendix O and an A.1 heading while retaining the overall narrative and section sequence.

P2.justification: v2 adds the six-scene NVS montage, updates the rig illustration, and redraws the pipeline more compactly. The main-text MoCap plot moves to appendix Figure 7; other displays are repositioned, and Table 7's 'Final Pose' heading becomes 'Cam. Init.' Existing result plots and table contents are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reporting consistency by correcting the appendix ATE to match Table 8 and revising the distance range to accommodate the stated 1.3 m average. Clearer diagrams, the NVS montage, and privacy-processing disclosure add modest clarity. The shortened validation description loses explicit joint 60 FPS recording detail, but the principal empirical evidence is preserved.
